# ClinSight Clinical Evidence Registry

> Primary Source Clinical Trial Benchmarks, Endpoints & Peer-Reviewed Publications
> Canonical URL: https://clinsight.pract.eu

## Indexed Clinical Studies Directory

- [NCT03734029 (DESTINY-Breast04)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03734029/): Phase 3 Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) in Breast Cancer (HER2-Low) — Median PFS 9.9 mo (T-DXd) vs 5.1 mo (TPC); Hazard Ratio 0.50 (95% CI 0.40–0.63; p < 0.001)
- [NCT03529110 (DESTINY-Breast03)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03529110/): Phase 3 Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) in Breast Cancer (HER2+) — Median PFS 28.8 mo (T-DXd) vs 6.8 mo (T-DM1); Hazard Ratio 0.33 (95% CI 0.26–0.43; p < 0.0001)
- [NCT04526691 (DESTINY-PanTumor02)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT04526691/): Phase 1 Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) in Solid Tumors (HER2-Expressing) — Confirmed ORR 37.1% across pan-tumor cohort; 61.3% in HER2 IHC 3+ patients
- [NCT04244461 (EV-302 / KEYNOTE-A39)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT04244461/): NA Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) in Genitourinary (Urothelial Cancer) — Median OS 31.5 mo (EV+Pembro) vs 16.1 mo (Chemotherapy); HR 0.47 (95% CI 0.38–0.58; p < 0.00001)
- [NCT03971409 (TROPiCS-02)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03971409/): Phase 2 Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) in Breast Cancer (HR+/HER2-) — Median PFS 5.5 mo vs 4.0 mo; Hazard Ratio 0.66 (95% CI 0.53–0.83; p = 0.0003)
- [NCT02638909 (KEYNOTE-024)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT02638909/): Phase 2 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors (PD-1/L1) in Lung Cancer (NSCLC PD-L1 ≥50%) — Median OS 30.0 mo (Pembrolizumab) vs 14.2 mo (Chemo); Hazard Ratio 0.63 (95% CI 0.47–0.86)
- [NCT02578680 (KEYNOTE-522)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT02578680/): Phase 3 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors (PD-1/L1) in Breast Cancer (Triple-Negative) — pCR Rate 64.8% (Pembro+Chemo) vs 51.2% (Placebo); Difference 13.6% (p < 0.001)
- [NCT02246621 (CheckMate-067)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT02246621/): Phase 3 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors (PD-1/L1) in Melanoma — Median OS 72.1 mo (Nivo+Ipi) vs 36.9 mo (Nivo) vs 19.9 mo (Ipi); HR 0.52 (p < 0.001)
- [NCT02511106 (ADAURA)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT02511106/): Phase 3 Targeted Small Molecules (TKIs) in Lung Cancer (EGFR-Mutated NSCLC) — 5-Year DFS 65% (Osimertinib) vs 19% (Placebo); Hazard Ratio 0.23 (95% CI 0.18–0.30; p < 0.001)
- [NCT03155620 (monarchE)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03155620/): Phase 2 Targeted Small Molecules (TKIs) in Breast Cancer (HR+/HER2-) — 5-Year IDFS 83.6% (Abemaciclib+ET) vs 76.0% (ET alone); HR 0.68 (95% CI 0.59–0.78; p < 0.0001)
- [NCT03041311 (CARTITUDE-1)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03041311/): Phase 2 Cell & Gene Therapy (CAR-T) in Hematologic (Multiple Myeloma) — Overall Response Rate 97.9%; Stringent Complete Response Rate 82.5%
- [NCT04181827 (CARTITUDE-4)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT04181827/): Phase 3 Cell & Gene Therapy (CAR-T) in Hematologic (Multiple Myeloma) — Median PFS Not Reached (Cilta-cel) vs 11.8 mo (Standard of Care); HR 0.26 (95% CI 0.18–0.38; p < 0.001)
- [NCT02348216 (ZUMA-1)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT02348216/): Phase 1, PHASE2 Cell & Gene Therapy (CAR-T) in Hematologic (Large B-Cell Lymphoma) — Objective Response Rate 83%; Complete Response Rate 58%
- [NCT03574597 (STEP 1)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03574597/): Phase 3 Incretin Mimetics (GLP-1 / GIP) in Obesity & Weight Management — Mean Weight Loss -14.9% (Semaglutide 2.4 mg) vs -2.4% (Placebo); Difference -12.4% (p < 0.001)
- [NCT03552718 (SELECT)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03552718/): Phase 1 Incretin Mimetics (GLP-1 / GIP) in Obesity & Cardiovascular Outcomes — Primary MACE Hazard Ratio 0.80 (95% CI 0.72–0.90; p < 0.001); 20% Risk Reduction
- [NCT04184622 (SURMOUNT-1)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT04184622/): Phase 3 Incretin Mimetics (GLP-1 / GIP) in Obesity & Weight Management — Mean Weight Reduction -20.9% (Tirzepatide 15 mg) vs -3.1% (Placebo); Difference -17.8% (p < 0.001)
- [NCT03057977 (DAPA-HF)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03057977/): Phase 3 Targeted Small Molecules (TKIs) in Heart Failure (HFrEF) — Primary Composite Outcome Hazard Ratio 0.74 (95% CI 0.65–0.85; p < 0.001); 26% Relative Risk Reduction
- [NCT04209855 (MIRASOL)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT04209855/): Phase 3 Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) in Gynecologic (Ovarian Cancer) — Median PFS 5.6 mo (Mirvetuximab) vs 4.0 mo (Chemo); Hazard Ratio 0.65 (95% CI 0.52–0.81; p < 0.0001)
- [NCT03422523 (POLARIX)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03422523/): Phase 2 Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) in Hematologic (Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma) — 2-Year PFS 76.7% (Pola-R-CHP) vs 70.2% (R-CHOP); Hazard Ratio 0.73 (95% CI 0.57–0.95; p = 0.02)
- [NCT03355911 (CodeBreaK 200)](https://clinsight.pract.eu/trials/NCT03355911/): Phase 3 Targeted Small Molecules (TKIs) in Lung Cancer (KRAS G12C NSCLC) — 1-Year PFS Rate 24.8% (Sotorasib) vs 10.1% (Docetaxel); Hazard Ratio 0.66 (95% CI 0.51–0.86; p = 0.0017)
